questions.question: Read: 'Sam has a red kite. He likes to fly it in the park.' Where does Sam fly his kite?
Read: 'Lily has a pet rabbit. Its name is Snowball.' What is the rabbit's name?
Read: 'The sun was shining, so Mia wore sunglasses.' Why did Mia wear sunglasses?
Read: 'Tom packed a sandwich, an apple, and water for lunch.' What did Tom pack to drink?
Read: 'The dog barked loudly when the mail carrier arrived.' Who arrived?
Read: 'Emma practiced piano every day for two weeks. At the concert, she played beautifully.' Why did Emma play well at the concert?
Read: 'The class planted seeds in April. By May, small green plants appeared.' What happened after the seeds were planted?
Read: 'Jake forgot his umbrella. When he got home, his clothes were wet.' Why were Jake's clothes wet?
Read: 'The library was quiet because many people were reading.' Why was the library quiet?
Read: 'Anna finished her homework before dinner and then watched a movie.' What did Anna do first?
Read: 'Carlos trained for the race every morning. On race day, he finished first.' Which sentence best explains why Carlos finished first?
Read: 'The power went out during the storm. The family used flashlights until the electricity returned.' Why did the family use flashlights?
options: It was dark because the power was out
They wanted to play a game
questions.answer: It was dark because the power was out

questions.question: Read: 'Nina brought extra snacks on the field trip. By lunchtime, several classmates had forgotten their lunches.' Why was bringing extra snacks a good idea?
Read: 'Ben saw dark clouds gathering. He canceled the picnic and planned it for another day.' What can you infer?
Read: 'After months of saving money from chores, Maya finally bought the bicycle she wanted.' What helped Maya buy the bicycle?
